attchmntText: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Thomas Scott India Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. The document outlines the company's transition to a tech-enabled online fashion retailer. H1 FY27 revenue breakdown shows 96% from B2C and 4% from B2B. Operational income for H1 FY27 was 1,447 million INR with an EBITDA margin of 13.13%. The company operates 4 manufacturing plants with a total capacity of 140,000 units per month and 4 fulfillment centers. Key metrics include a 3-year PAT CAGR of 88% and a 3-year revenue CAGR of 60%. The board comprises Brijgopal Bang, Vedant Bang, Vandana Bang, Usha Ghelani, Kavita Chhajer, and Anuradha Paraskar. The presentation highlights the launch of GenAI tools named thread.ai and catalog.ai in pilot stages.

attchmntText: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Thomas Scott India Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 12th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 7,892.11 lakhs for the quarter and 14,473.96 lakhs for the half year. Profit before tax stood at 811.36 lakhs for the quarter and 1,499.54 lakhs for the half year. Net profit was 628.51 lakhs for the quarter and 1,172.32 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 4.26 for the quarter and 7.97 for the half year. Total assets were 26,168.83 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The financial statements were reviewed by Bharat Gupta and Co.
